def find_original_ring(N, ring):
    for i in range(N):
        original = [0] * N
        original[i] = ring[0]
        original[(i - 1) % N] = ring[1] - ring[0]
        original[(i + 1) % N] = ring[-1] - ring[0]
        valid = True
        for j in range(2, N):
            if original[j % N] != ring[j] - original[(j - 1) % N]:
                valid = False
                break
        if valid:
            return original

def reconstruct_original_ring(N, sums):
    # Initialize the original ring with None values
    original_ring = [None] * N
    
    # Create a list of indices sorted by the sums
    indices = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: sums[i])
    
    # Assign the first value directly since it can be derived
    original_ring[indices[0]] = sums[indices[0]] - sums[indices[(N-1) % N]]
    
    # Fill the rest of the original ring using the previously calculated values
    for i in range(1, N):
        prev_index = indices[i-1]
        current_index = indices[i]
        next_index = indices[(i+1) % N]
        
        original_ring[current_index] = sums[current_index] - original_ring[prev_index]
    
    return original_ring

def reconstruct_original_ring(N, sums):
    # Initialize the original ring with zeros
    original = [0] * N
    
    # Calculate the first element of the original ring
    original[0] = sums[1] - sums[0]
    
    # Fill the rest of the original ring
    for i in range(1, N-1):
        original[i] = sums[i+1] - sums[i-1]
    
    # Calculate the last element of the original ring
    original[-1] = sums[0] - sums[N-2]
    
    return original
